jane_customer: Hey @maya / @support — our prod parser keeps failing on structured output. Parser error: \"Unexpected end of JSON input\". Started ~2024-09-10 after a model bump. Also seeing billing spike from repeated retries. Request sample attached.

maya: Sorry — can you paste the raw response body you receive (not the parsed object)? model + stream flag?

jane_customer: Here's the curl and the exact chunks we see from the stream:
```bash
curl -s -H \"Authorization: Bearer ****\" -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\
  -d '{\"input\":\"give me the file path\"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate?model=rwd-3b&stream=true
```

And the two consecutive chunks we collect (client concat):
```
chunk #12: {\"file\":{\"path\":\"C:\\\\temp\\\\fi
chunk #13: le.txt\"},\"status\":\"done\"}
```
Note chunk #12 ends with \"C:\\\\temp\\\\fi\" and #13 starts with \"le.txt\" — when concatenated into a single string it's valid, but our streaming parser reports EOF mid-string when chunk boundaries are processed separately by a streaming JSON parser.

samir: That looks like the escape sequence \"\\\\\" (0x5c 0x5c) being split across a chunk boundary. Streaming JSON parsers can choke if they try to parse partial tokens. Which client/stream parser are you using?

jane_customer: node-fetch + ndjson-stream + JSON.parse on line buffer. If I set stream=false on the API it works (no splitting). But we rely on streaming for low-latency in prod.

maya: Two things: 1) can you DM me x-request-id (from response headers) for a refund/billing look; 2) can you try a quick client workaround: buffer until you see a closing quote or use a chunk-aware NDJSON parser that waits for complete objects before JSON.parse.

eli_ops: Filing ENG ticket — reproducer looks solid. Workaround suggestions: a) use NDJSON framing (one JSON object per line) so clients can split on \\n; b) or have runtime emit a framing delimiter between top-level objects. We'll prioritize detection of escape-split cases.

samir: Created ENG-4823. Short-term we can add a server-side mitigation to avoid breaking inside escape sequences when streaming model outputs that are explicitly JSON (structured mode). We'll test a patch.

jane_customer: Thanks. Also, billing: we retried 12x automatically after parser error — can billing remove retries? x-request-id is 01abc234def.

maya: Got the id. I'll escalate billing and follow up here. ETA 24h. For now please keep stream=false if you need to stop charges.

rdw-bot: Incident INC-2024-3347 created by samir; link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2024-3347

samir: If anyone else hits this, please attach raw chunks and the client code. Quick repro script we used:
```js
const fetch = require('node-fetch');
(async()=>{
  const res = await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate?model=rwd-3b&stream=true', {method:'POST', body: JSON.stringify({input:'give path'})});
  for await (const chunk of res.body){
    process.stdout.write(chunk);
  }
})();
```

maya: Closing loop: I'll update when billing completes. ENG will follow up on rollout plan for the server mitigation"
